I work with organizations in carbon markets, climate risk, and
agricultural sustainability that need rigorous, defensible
quantitative analysis. If you have a project in mind - or just want
to talk through whether it's a fit - I'd be glad to hear from you.

When you reach out, a short description of your project, timeline,
and the data you're working with helps me give you a useful first
response.
